description: Active promotions/discount codes for a brand: code, discount, terms, valid_until. Only live offers (expired and single-use codes left out). Each row says how it is known: verification = seen_on_brand_homepage (read off the brand's own homepage) or third_party_unverified (listed on public coupon sites, not tested at checkout), or seen_in_brand_signup_popup (the offer the brand's own sign-up popup or form shows for signing up, plus its event sign-ups such as Black Friday early access; no code is shown for these). Freshness-stamped. Included in RivalSweeper plans (developer API keys: 1 credit, no data = no charge).
name: get_active_promotions_and_coupons
title: Active promotions
